gloss: endlessly; as far as the eye can see; thoroughly; to the very end

definitions.gloss: endlessly; on and on; as far as one can see
definitions.explanation: Of space or a continuing scene: extending without any visible limit. Typically used of roads, skies, fields, and the sea.

definitions.gloss: thoroughly; to the very end; utterly
definitions.explanation: Of attitude or degree: refusing to stop or compromise, or being something completely. Often carries admiration or exasperation, depending on context.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}はどこまでも{続|つづ}く。
examples.english: The road goes on and on.

examples.japanese: どこまでも{青|あお}い{空|そら}が{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: An endlessly blue sky stretched out above.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}の{外|そと}には、どこまでも{畑|はたけ}が{続|つづ}く{景色|けしき}が{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: Outside the window, fields stretched away as far as the eye could see.

examples.japanese: どこまでも{優|やさ}しい{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He is kind through and through.

examples.japanese: どこまでも{自分|じぶん}の{意見|いけん}を{曲|ま}げなかった。
examples.english: She refused to bend her opinion, no matter what.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はどこまでも{正直|しょうじき}で、{損|そん}をすると{分|わ}かっていても{嘘|うそ}をつかない。
examples.english: He is honest to the core; he won't lie even when he knows it will cost him.

notes:
Composed of どこ (where) + まで (up to) + も (even). The literal "even to wherever" underlies both senses: unlimited extent in space, and refusal to stop short in attitude.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どこまでも{続|つづ}く: to stretch on endlessly
- どこまでも{広|ひろ}がる: to spread out without limit
- どこまでも{追|お}いかける: to chase someone to the ends of the earth
- どこまでも{自分|じぶん}らしい: utterly true to oneself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いつまでも: forever — the same shape applied to time rather than space
- {徹底的|てっていてき}に: thoroughly — sense 2 only, and more clinical
- あくまで: to the last; persistently — close to sense 2, but stresses sticking to a stated position
